name: list_services
description: List the current services, prices, descriptions, and stable service IDs offered by Headquarters on Main. Call this before discussing available services or booking.

name: list_shop_openings
description: Check booked appointments and working hours to find openings on a requested local date, either across all active barbers or for a caller's preferred barber. Use before requiring a service when a caller wants to schedule and is choosing a barber, day, or time. Omit date to check today and omit barberName when anyone is acceptable.

date.description: Optional local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit to check today.

barberName.description: Optional preferred barber name as spoken by the caller, such as Brayden. Omit to check every active barber.

name: list_barbers
description: List only active barbers who offer the selected service. Use a serviceId returned by list_services.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

name: list_available_slots
description: Return currently open 30-minute appointment start times for an eligible barber on a specific local calendar date. Call this immediately before offering times and again if the caller changes the barber, service, or date.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

barberId.description: The barber ID returned by list_barbers.

date.description: Local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

name: book_appointment
description: Create a confirmed appointment after the caller explicitly confirms the service, barber, local date, time, name, and callback number. Use only IDs and a time returned by the earlier tools.

serviceId.description: The stable service ID returned by list_services.

barberId.description: The barber ID returned by list_barbers.

date.description: Local appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

phone.description: Customer's confirmed callback phone number, preferably E.164.

notes.description: Optional concise appointment notes requested by the customer.

smsConsent.description: True only when the caller explicitly agrees to receive this appointment's confirmation and reminder text messages; otherwise false.
